comment: Input index 4 is RECALL_INPUT and is the one port in this plugin given no configInput name, so Rack's tooltip for it is empty; it sits under the RECL label and works as that button does. The track outputs get no family because TURING mode changes what they carry from a trigger to a stepped voltage. The U1 and U2 jacks and knobs get no family and no range because their meaning is set per track from a menu. Props are recorded once for each group of eight identical per-track ports. The MOD and track-number displays are custom widgets with no ParamWidget, so the menus they carry cannot be reached by clicking them for help.
